messages:
tara.eng: Observed sudden surge of 503s on embeds-prod-eu at 06:11 UTC. Traces point to header parser re-entry under certain request patterns causing kvcache pressure. I pushed v5.1.2-quickfix. Requesting expedited micro-pin deploy (0.5%) with short soak. Need ops + sre approval.

deploy-bot: New deploy request recorded: service=embeds-prod-eu image=v5.1.2-quickfix requester=tara.eng default-policy-canary=10% you requested canary=0.5% approvals-required=2. Approve with `/approve deploy 2830001234` or react :white_check_mark:.

nidhi_sre: Can we avoid a full skip-canary? micro-pin 0.5% is OK but require 4m observation and a prometheus snapshot pre-deploy. Also need the rollback image and the quick rollback command posted here.

carlos_ops: I will only sign off if rollback artifact is provided and ops has a playbook link. I'll take pager for 50m. Post rollback snippet please.

tara.eng: rollback image pinned to v5.1.1-stable. No DB or schema changes. Rollback snippet: `deployctl rollback --service embeds-prod-eu --image v5.1.1-stable && deployctl wait --stable embeds-prod-eu` Playbook: https://playbooks/internal/embeds/rollback-2830001234 (shortlink). Prometheus snapshot: https://telemetry/internal/snaps/2830001234-pre

emma_pm: Product approves expedited micro-pin. Impact: medium for batch embedding jobs in EU. We'll hold comms until we confirm stability.

release-bot: Draft release note created: "hotfix(embeds): fix header-parser re-entry causing kvcache pressure and 503s (v5.1.2-quickfix)" edit at https://internal/releases/2830001234-edit

nidhi_sre: /approve deploy 2830001234  approving conditioned on canary=0.5% + 4m soak and PM signoff.

carlos_ops: /approve deploy 2830001234  approved. Pager duty assigned to me for 50m. Rollback command saved.

deploy-bot: Approvals (2) received. Initiating controlled micro-pin rollout: canary=0.5% -> observe=4m -> promote. Command: `deployctl rollout start --service embeds-prod-eu --image v5.1.2-quickfix --canary 0.5 --timeout 4m --requester tara.eng`

deploy-bot: Canary slice created: embeds-v5-1-2-qf-canary-1 (Ready). Telemetry stream: https://telemetry/internal/embeds/2830001234-canary.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics after 4m: errors=0, p99=425ms (baseline 430ms), kvcache misses back to baseline. No error traces. Promoting per rollout policy.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Deployment status: SUCCESS. Release URL: https://deployments.redwood/2830001234

tara.eng: Thanks all. I'll watch the dashboards for 1h and escalate if anything looks off.

emma_pm: Release notes updated and queued for comms if stable after 1h. Noted the micro-pin approach in the notes.

carlos_ops: Monitoring ok so far. No alerts. Keeping pager for the remainder of the window.

nidhi_sre: Added short-lived regression alert: p99 delta > 25% OR error-rate > 0.4% over 30m.

tara.eng: Closing this thread after 1h if no regressions. Good work everyone :tada:
